title: ADR
description: One Architecture Decision Record. ADRs together form the Architectural Direction, defined in definitions.yaml: they are read from the highest number downward, a later ADR supersedes an earlier one, and an ADR is never edited once written; a change is a new ADR. An ADR governs direction and does not describe current state.

Number.description: The sequence number, which orders the ADRs and decides which supersedes which: the higher number wins.

Title.description: What was decided, in a few words.

Date.description: The day the decision was taken.

Context.description: The forces and circumstances that called for the decision.

Decisions.description: What is decided, when several decisions are taken together. A single decision is written as decision, so each ADR has exactly one valid shape.

SingleDecision.description: An ADR that takes one decision.

SeveralDecisions.description: An ADR that takes several decisions together.
